extracted.rationale: BLA highly enriched in glutamatergic principal neurons; fear neurons are a functional subset of BLA principal cells, establishing glutamatergic identity.
Directly defines BLA fear neurons as a functional population activated by the conditioned stimulus, non-overlapping with extinction neurons.
scRNA-seq confirms only a subset of amygdalar neuronal types is transcriptionally fear-responsive, supporting the engram/activity-defined nature of the fear neuron population.

considered_not_extracted.reason: GABAergic interneuron census of LA/BA; fear neurons are glutamatergic principal cells, not interneurons.
Glutamatergic identity of BLA already covered by Chung (3103554); avoid redundant nt_type source.
Glutamatergic projection neuron identity redundant with Chung (3103554).
80-85% glutamatergic figure redundant with nt_type source already added.
Cross-species (primate) basolateral glutamatergic composition; not specific to the fear-ON neuron functional identity.
Thy1/Ntsr2/Rspo2/Wnt7a describe the 'Fear-Off' (extinction) population, NOT fear-ON neurons; already used on basal_amygdala_extinction_neuron.
Calbindin interneurons activated during fear extinction; not the fear-ON principal neuron population.
Paralaminar nucleus immature excitatory neurons; unrelated to fear neuron.
